title: fix(app-shell): PageView refreshes a page action’s data in place on the invalidation bus instead of remounting the page (objectui#10519)
body:
Fixes #10519
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), from claim comment 5855640194 on objectui#10519, executing the unblock 5854561985 and seat decision B 5830213285. Branch `claude/issue-10519-pageview-refresh-in-place`, cut from `origin/main` `b5b6f37531` (BASE); head `4620ba39d2`.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`: the `refreshKey` counter is gone, together with the `key` on both render branches (`InterfaceListPage`, ADR-0047 interface mode, and `SchemaRenderer`, the page). The console action runtime's `onRefresh` now points at a module-level `declarePageDataChanged`, which is `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` from `@object-ui/react`: a page binds no object and the runtime's refresh carries none, so the bus's documented unknown-scope value is the page's scope. The node `context` handed to `SchemaRenderer` is `{ params }` alone. `useState` is no longer imported. No prop, export or schema key moves.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.context-9673.test.tsx`: the expected node context is `{ params }` (it was `params` plus `refreshKey: 0`); the header sentence says why.
- `packages/app-shell/src/no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet.test.ts`: the header no longer calls `PageView.onRefresh` a user "Refresh this page" affordance. By a source reading of `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `onRefresh` is fed only by the runtime's post-action refresh (`api`, flow and server-action success, undo, screen-flow completion), and `PageView` has no refresh control. `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView` joins `IN_SCOPE`. Every other assertion is kept.
- New pin `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` (below).
- `.changeset/10519-pageview-refresh-in-place.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

## H1 — premise: every listed page block re-reads in place on `origin/main`

Runtime census on BASE `b5b6f37531`, through a scratch probe (deleted, never committed): the real `SchemaRenderer`, each plugin's real registration, one counting fake data source per row; reads on mount, then `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, then reads again. A bare `useDataInvalidation` reader beside each block is the positive control, and its nonce moved 0 → 1 in every row. The probe lived under `app-shell` because the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/plugin-*` specifier to source there; committed, it would trip `check:phantom-deps` (the objectui#10572 PR made the same call).

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event | re-reads in place |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-grid` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-chart` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `detail-view` (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `list-view` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-kanban` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-metric` (aggregate) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form`, default arm (findOne) | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: drawer` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: modal` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: split` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: tabbed` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-form` `formType: wizard` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-calendar` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-gallery` | 1 → 2 | yes |

| `object-gantt` | 1 → 2 | yes |

| `element:repeater` | 1 → 2 | yes |
| `object-map` | not probed here: its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` mocks `react-map-gl/maplibre`, which does not resolve from app-shell; that pin ran green on BASE in the same lock run (3 cases) | yes |
| `list` (the alias) | 0 → 0 | NOT MEASURED: under this probe the alias resolved to a renderer that issued no read and forwarded `objectName` / `viewType` to a DOM element (the first dev report recorded the same 0); the studio palette does not offer it |

The studio palette's data category (`BLOCK_TYPE_META`) is `grid`, `object-grid`, `object-form`, `object-metric`, `object-kanban`; every object-bound entry is in the table. Every block decision B lists, the six `object-form` arms included, re-reads exactly once after the bus event; none refreshes only because the page remounts. So the premise holds and no reader goes first.

## H2 — the remount, reproduced on BASE

The new pin run against BASE `PageView.tsx` (byte-identical to BASE by blob hash `9de300582c`) with the head pins kept, before any source edit: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`.

- SchemaRenderer branch, red on (a): `The page action REMOUNTED the page: the SchemaRenderer consumer mounted a second time` — the `object-gantt` stand-in's instance counter read 2 after one `api` action.
- interface branch, red on (a): `The page action REMOUNTED the interface page` — the `interface-list-page` node after the action was not the node before it.
- lit control green: a change declared on the bus directly reached the metric and the stand-in once each, with no action run.

## Pins and ablations

`PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` renders `PageView` for real under `MemoryRouter`, `AdapterCtx` and `SchemaRendererProvider`, with the real console action runtime, the real `page`, `page:accordion` and `action:button` renderers, the real `object-metric` (plugin-dashboard) and `object-form` (plugin-form) blocks, and, on the interface branch, the real `InterfaceListPage` over plugin-list's `ListView`. The stand-in registered as `object-gantt` follows the `ObjectView.refreshInPlace-10035` precedent: it reads the real bus hook, counts its own queries, and carries an instance id and a scroll box. The page action is a real `api` action (`target: /api/v1/environments`) through the runtime's `apiHandler`, an authenticated raw-HTTP call that fires no dataSource `onMutation`.

After one page action:

- (a) the same tree: the stand-in mounted exactly once (instance id unchanged), its scroll box is the same node with `scrollTop` still 120, the metric node is the same, the form's `name` input is the same node and still reads the half-typed `User typed`, and the collapsed accordion panel still has `aria-expanded="false"`; on the interface branch the `interface-list-page` node and `ListView`'s own `refresh-button` node are unchanged.
- (b) each bus reader re-read exactly once: the metric's `aggregate` delta is 1, the stand-in's query delta is 1, and `ListView`'s list query delta (its `$top: 0` count probe excluded) is 1.
- lit control: `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` with no action reaches the metric and the stand-in once each.

Red on base, green on head, and two ablation legs, all on committed state with every restore spelled `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` and proven by blob hash, `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status` clean:

| leg | mutation (on-disk proof) | result over the pin, the ratchet and context-9673 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1, reverse run | `PageView.tsx` checked out at BASE (blob `9de300582c` == BASE blob; `key={refreshKey}` sites 2, `notifyDataChanged` sites 0), head pins kept | `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`: ratchet red (`expected [ …(2) ] to deeply equal []`, the two key sites), context-9673 red on both cases (`+ "refreshKey": 0`), the pin red on (a) on both branches; the ratchet's scan-path guard and the pin's lit control green. Restore: blob `8e96f4adbf` == HEAD blob, diff empty, status clean |
| A2, the host declares nothing | through `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' });` hit 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `8e96f4adbf` → `83a296ea0a` | `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`: the pin red on (b) on both branches (`The metric did not re-read after the action`, `The list did not re-query after the action`); (a), the lit control, the ratchet and context-9673 green. Restore by the tool: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |

Each leg fails on the half the defect predicts and nowhere else, so each pin fails for the reason it names. No `dist/` preflight applies: every test here imports `PageView` from `src`, and the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/*` specifier to source.

## Gates (head `4620ba39d2`)

- Pins at head: the five `PageView` test files (`PageView.refreshInPlace-10519`, `no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet`, `PageView.context-9673`, `PageView.test`, `page-kind-writing-end-9718`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 12 passed (12)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, script name echoed), after `turbo run build` of the 28-task dependency closure (cache-restored, `dist/index.d.ts` present): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Lint, narrowed and measured: `eslint --format json` over the four touched files reads 4 files, 0 errors, 27 warnings, all `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`, the warning-level rule the package already carries on every `as any` (the base `PageView.tsx` had them). Population: `eslint --format json .` in `packages/app-shell` (what CI's `turbo run lint` runs there) reads 1298 files, 0 errors, 3207 warnings. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (`projectService` / `parserOptions.project` absent), so this diff moves no untouched file's verdict.
- `check-changeset-presence`: 4 source files of 1 released package changed, 1 changeset declared, exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:phantom-deps`, `changeset:check` (fixed, no-major), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: all exit 0 with their OK line.
- Declared to CI: the full app-shell test suite and the repo-wide `pnpm test`; the scope named above is the union of every test file that imports `PageView` or that this diff edits.

## Serial

Before the final push, `origin/main` was fetched into the private ref `refs/issue-10519/main` (`805abe240c`): one commit landed since BASE (objectui#10763), and it touched no file this branch touches (only two other cards' changesets). `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD refs/issue-10519/main` exit 0 (clean). No merge commit was needed.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed, observation only: under the census probe the `list` registry key resolved to a renderer that forwarded `objectName` and `viewType` to a DOM element and issued no read (React's unknown-prop warning), i.e. plugin-list's `list` alias did not win the key in that import order. The palette does not offer `list`, no consumer was identified, and the first dev report saw the same 0. Dedupe words if anyone measures it: `list alias registry collision`, `ListViewRenderer list key`.
- Not filed, nit: `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s `onRefresh` doc comment still describes the refresh as "bump a refresh key to re-fetch embedded data"; `ObjectView` still bumps one (plus the bus, objectui#10035), so the sentence is stale only for this host.
- A `Refresh` button inside `ListView`'s toolbar (`refresh-button`) is a user refresh affordance and is unrelated to `PageView.onRefresh`; the pin uses that node only as an identity witness.
